title: Curse of the Black Stone
start: Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir at Daemonheim.

requirements.t: The following are not required to start the quest, but must be done to complete it:
Completion of the Temple of Aminishi (any mode)
Completion of the Dragonkin Laboratory (any mode)
Completion of the Shadow Reef (any mode)

items.t: Any set of equipment that allows access to the Black Knights' Fortress
Bronze med helm and iron chainbody
Black full helm, black platebody and black platelegs (all variants work, including trimmed, gold-trimmed, heraldic and bugged)
Elite black helm, elite black platebody and elite black platelegs
Dagon'hai hat, Dagon'hai robe top and Dagon'hai robe bottom
Black Knight captain's helm, Black Knight captain's cuirass and Black Knight captain's gown (the override version works)
Cosmetic overrides will prevent access to the Black Knight's Fortress
Pat of butter (optional, not needed if picking or breaking the locks on Tessa's manacles)

recommended.t: Ring of kinship for teleporting to Daemonheim
Arc journal for teleporting to the Arc
'Chipped' Varrock teleport for teleporting to the Varrock Museum
Traveller's necklace or wicked hood for teleporting to Wizard's Tower
Means of teleportation to reach Adamant dragon dungeon, e.g. Dungeoneering cape or metallic dragon trinkets
The Heart teleport or Desert amulet 2, 3, or 4
Aminishi teleport for quick access to the Temple of Aminishi
Dragonkin Laboratory teleport for quick access to the Dragonkin Laboratory
Shadow Reef teleport for quick access to The Shadow Reef
Wilderness sword for quick access to Edgeville
Mask of the Yellow Wyrm or quick teleport to Kharid-et Dig Site for quick teleport to the Citharede Abbey
2 Archaeology teleports for quick access to the Black Knight's Base

kills.t: Enemies within the Temple of Aminishi (if not already done at least once before)
Enemies within the Dragonkin Laboratory (if not already done at least once before)
Enemies within the Shadow Reef (if not already done at least once before)
6 Crassian warriors and 6 Crassian scouts (both level 75)
kills.l: Crassian warrior (Curse of the Black Stone)

rewards.t: 10% reduction of damage received in the Temple of Aminishi elite dungeon.
10% reduction of damage received in the Dragonkin Laboratory elite dungeon.
10% reduction of damage received in the Shadow Reef elite dungeon.
Players can now purchase an upgrade to the Elite Dungeon chests for 750,000 Dungeoneering tokens, which allows banking within the dungeon and always has a 20% chance to double a boss drop.

steps.t: Use the ring of kinship to quickly teleport to Daemonheim. You can get one for free as you'll need to visit Daemonheim many times during the quest.
Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir beside Marmaros the rewards trader in Daemonheim. [Chat: 2 [Curse of the Black Stone] › Accept]
Travel to Waiko via Quartermaster Gully in the northern part of Port Sarim.
Talk to Zhuka (bamboo merchant) at the southern part of the marketplace. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Jade Spider?]
p: Digging to try and find the note on Whale's Maw

steps.t: Travel to Whale's Maw by talking to Quartermaster Gully (via travel option and select Whale's Maw).
Talk to Sea Witch Kaula at the northwestern part of the island. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Jade Spider]
Dig the lump of sand near the western-most ship. [Chat: 2 Get on with tortle hunting.]
Check the tortle to the south to obtain a note from the Jade Spider.
Travel to Tuai Leit via Quartermaster Gully.
Speak to Sensei Seaworth [Chat: 1 Ask about the Jade Spider.], who is in the south-west part of the stone market in the middle of the region.
Travel to Goshima via Quartermaster Gully. [Chat: 1 Search for the Jade spider.]
Kill all 12 crassians on the island.
Open and go through the Gate of Goshima and talk to Madame Shih (the Jade Spider) in the easternmost building. [Chat: 1 She mentioned something]

sub.t: If you've already completed Temple of Aminishi at least once, you may skip the battle. [Chat: 1 Skip the dungeon.]
Otherwise complete the Temple of Aminishi and defeat Seiryu the Azure Serpent before returning back to Madame Shih.

steps.t: Talk to Mr Mordaut in his office in the basement of Varrock Museum that is accessed behind the stairs. [Chat: 2 [Curse of the Black Stone]]

sub.t: Use a 'chipped' Varrock teleport, Dave's spellbook, the Varrock lodestone or Fort Forinthry lodestone to get to the museum quickly.

p: The door that leads to Mr Mordaut Tribute, right behind the first flight of stairs
The location of the unlit fireplace at Daemonheim, near the path towards the boat

steps.t: Go to Daemonheim and investigate the fireplace to the east of the fountain to find a carved dragonstone (left).
Cut your uncut dragonstone to create the carved dragonstone (right). [Chat: 1 Create right eye.]
Use either the left or right carved dragonstone on the fountain. [Chat: 1 Place the stone in the eye socket.]
Enter the crumbling watchtower to the west.
Talk to Hannibus in the west room.
Head to the room with the entrance to the adamant dragon dungeon in the Brimhaven Dungeon between the fire giants and black demons, and north of the iron and steel dragons.

sub.t: Either via the dungeon entrance just west of the Karamja lodestone and navigating to the room
via a metallic dragon trinkets' teleport option [Chat: 5 Adamant Dragons - Brimhaven Adamant Dungeon]
via the Dungeoneering cape teleport [Chat: 0 More... › 6 Brimhaven metal dragon dungeon] and heading north-west
with the Kethsi ring.
If you used a Kethsi ring or metallic trinket to teleport directly into the dungeon, first go out by ascending the stairs.

steps.t: Enter the adamant dragon dungeon [Chat: 1 [Curse of the Black Stone]] and investigate the mithril smelter on the easternmost wall of the easternmost room to obtain a metallic object.

sub.t: If you have Eek with you, you may investigate the adamant smelter for some extra dialogue.

steps.t: Talk to the adamant dragon in the south-western room to heat the metallic object. [Chat: 1 Can you heat this metal? › 3 Your baby is cold, warm her up.]
p: Adamant dragon (Curse of the Black Stone)

steps.t: With a rope in the backpack, investigate one of the pits north of the entrance. [Chat: 2 Attach a rope and drop the heated metal into the pit.]
Investigate the dragon head near the stairs. [Chat: 1 Smash the tablet on the teeth.]
p: Place: Dragon head (Curse of the Black Stone)

steps.t: Head back to Kerapac's Lab by entering the crumbling watchtower in Daemonheim.
Investigate the effigy shelves in the room with Hannibus. [Chat: 2 I'm looking for clues.]
Referencing the image to the right, activate the following dragonkin statues in any order: 1, 3, 5
Enter the portal in the northern room. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Kerapac.
Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir back in Daemonheim. [Chat: 3 [Curse of the Black Stone]]

sub.t: If you have already completed Dragonkin Laboratory at least once, you may skip the battle. [Chat: 2 Skip the dungeon.]
Otherwise complete the Dragonkin Laboratory and defeat the Black Stone Dragon before returning back to Bryll Thosdottir.

steps.t: Travel back to Goshima. [Chat: 1 [Curse of the Black Stone]] (A cutscene will start)
Head back to Daemonheim and talk to Bryll Thoksdottir. [Chat: 2 [Curse of the Black Stone]]
Speak to Wizard Myrtle near the Wizards' Tower. [Chat: 1 Curse of the Black Stone. › 4 Can you help me get the fish now? › 1 Yes.]

sub.t: Use the traveller's necklace or wicked hood to navigate to the Wizards' Tower, or use the fairy ring DIS to teleport, or run to it from the Draynor lodestone.

steps.t: Give Wizard Myrtle any raw fish and a law rune to obtain small raw sillago.
Fill the empty enchanted "vacuum" vial on the Ice Mountain near Edgeville.
Dry the wet seaweed while standing near the huge fountain at Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede.
p: Place: Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede

steps.t: Combine the potion of waterbreathing and drink it.
Return to Daemonheim and speak with Hannibus next to the heroes of the Shadow Reef and the Fremennik ship (Shadow reef) on the east coast.

sub.t: If he is not there, instead talk to Bryll Thoksdottir. [Chat: 3 [Curse of the Black Stone]]

p: Place: heroes of the Shadow Reef

steps.t: Travel to the Edgeville lodestone to activate the artefact northwest. [Chat: 1 Yes - Meet with Hannibus.]
Talk to Mr Mordaut at the Varrock Museum. [Chat: 2 [Curse of the Black Stone]]
Travel to the Heart of Gielinor to meet with Vindicta. [Chat: 1 Yes - Meet with Vindicta.]

sub.t: You may need to leave the dungeon via the lift, and re-enter for the chat option to appear.

steps.t: Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir near the ring of kinship's teleport location [Chat: 2 [Curse of the Black Stone]] and then Quartermaster Gully near the Heroes of the Shadow Reef (you may talk to him at Port Sarim).
Travel to Waiko and speak to Steven's wife the seagull in the north-east (top of northernmost rock pillar)
p: The location of Steven the seagull at Waiko

steps.t: Speak to the 6 seagulls (locations on the map) to find evidence.

sub.t: On a water barrel near the Khan's house, on the eastern part of the island
In the village, on a water barrel east of the southern pier
On the southern pier, on a water barrel
On a crate in the shipwreck, near the western pier
On a crate on the western pier
Inside of a cage on the northern pier

steps.t: Go back to Steven's wife and speak to her.
Talk to Quartermaster Gully at the war table, east of Daemonheim.
Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir.
Talk to Bosun Higgs.
Talk to Lieutenant Crane next to the map table in the Black Knights' Base in the very south of Taverley Dungeon [Chat: 1 Evie sent me.]

sub.t: Teleport via an Archaeology teleport or the master outfit [Chat: 2 Collectors › 5 Isaura] and heading south.
Via the Dungeoneering cape [Chat: 0 More... › 1 Taverley blue dragon dungeon] and heading east through the gate, then south.

steps.t: Run north-west of the Edgeville lodestone to reach the Black Knights' Fortress.
Talk to the fortress guard at the entrance of the fortress while wearing the disguise.
Interact with Tessa's suit of armour in the western barracks room.
Head to the north west corner and head up the stairs.
Talk to the slave standing along the north wall on the floor 2 of the Black Knights' Fortress.
Talk to Lieutenant Crane about Tessa:

sub.t: If wearing a ring of charos (a) lie to skip the steps to free Tessa. [Chat: 2 [Lie - Ring of Charos] She's fine. › 1 Yes, I just want to kill the ambassador.]
Otherwise [Chat: 1 She's a slave.] and proceed with these steps:
Return to the fortress and interact with Tessa's suit of armour.
Head upstairs to smuggle out Tessa. [Chat: 3 Pick lock.]
Give her the suit of armour. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 Yes. › Any]
Return to Lieutenant Crane.
Head back to Daemonheim and speak to Bosun Higgs at the war table.
Talk to Commandant Bletchley in the Black Knights' Fortress on the floor 2. He is standing along the north wall.
Talk to Lieutenant Crane.

p: The Ambassador appears and kills Madame Shih's crew.
Crane, Higgs and the player confront Bletchley on the roof of the fortress.

steps.t: Speak to Bryll Thoksdottir near the war table in east Daemonheim.

sub.t: If you have already completed the dungeon, skip the battle. [Chat: 2 Skip the dungeon.]
Otherwise, choose any option for your speech. [Chat: Any]
Complete the Shadow Reef.
If this is your first time completing the dungeon, travel back to Bryll Thoksdottir after defeating the Ambassador.

p: The group gathered to fight The Ambassador.

get_inside.text: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.
pic: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.

get_inside.text: Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
pic: The place where players arrive if they travel to Daemonheim by boat.

get_inside.text: Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.

Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.
